mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers increased investor confidence in labor market strength, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicate robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression or the 60-day returns are not higher than average in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (INDPRO > 105), elevated production and inventory buildup signal peak demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO exceeds 105 in the current period
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor participation (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening job market, fostering investor optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expanding labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising long-term interest rates and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5% in the current period
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates a virtuous cycle of economic expansion, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression or the 20-day returns are not higher than average in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4%), persistent labor market stress reduces investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE exceeds 4% in the current period
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
